short_title: What makes these perfect circles on whales? 🐋
title_options: What makes these perfect circles on whales? 🐋
Perfect round holes in whales: who did it? 🦈
This tiny shark cuts circles out of whales 🦈
seo_intro:
What makes the perfect round scars on whales? A giant shark, a parasite, or something smaller?
The culprit is the cookiecutter shark, a deep-sea shark about 20 inches long that latches on with suction-cup lips, bites, and spins to carve out a round plug.
